channel.title: San Diego Community Newsgroup - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from San Diego Community Newsgroup (sdnews.com)

item.title: Credit One Bank to pay over $10M to settle lawsuit over debt collection calls
item.description: Credit One Bank will pay just over $10 million to settle a consumer protection lawsuit over alleged harassing debt collection calls.

item.title: Weekend rail closure scheduled Between Oceanside, San Diego
item.description: North County Transit - San Diego Railroad will suspend all coastal rail service this weekend, starting Saturday, to perform routine railroad maintenance.

item.title: Opinion: Why American cities must invest in the creative economy
item.description: Cities that make creativity central to their economic and civic strategies reap far more than cultural prestige — they gain global competitiveness.

item.title: No winner, bigger prize: Mega Millions jackpot climbs to $438M
item.description: Lottery fever is building again after no ticket matched all six numbers in Friday night’s Mega Millions drawing, sending the jackpot soaring to an estimated $438 million for Tuesday.

item.title: Crews rescue man dumped from trash bin into trash truck
item.description: The trash truck driver had unwittingly dumped the man into the back of the loaded EDCO vehicle in San Ysidro, authorities said.

item.title: Firefighters called to residential fire in University Heights
item.description: San Diego crews arrived at the scene of the blaze, in the 4300 block of Georgia Street, just before 6 a.m.

item.title: MTS analiza aumentos de tarifas o recortes de servicio. ¿Qué prefiere usted?
item.description: Y forma parte de los miles que podrían verse afectados por el déficit de 528 millones de dólaresque enfrenta el Sistema de Tránsito Metropolitano de San Diego (MTS) en los próximos tres años fiscales.

item.title: Raise fares or cut service: MTS budget woes force bad options on riders who rely on transit
item.description: MTS officials are hosting workshops to confront harsh choices given their budget deficit. Riders who need transit don't have great options.

item.title: SDFC execs reach out ahead of new season, dedicating court in Colina del Sol
item.description: SDFC's Parks & Pitches multi-sport courts initiative develops courts and fields in San Diego public parks.

item.title: Still hungry, San Diego FC opens sophomore season with 5-0 thumping of Montréal
item.description: San Diego FC opened its second season as an MLS franchise with a win, picking up right where it left off last season.
